critical.evidence: The production collector accepted a complete 20-arm synthetic campaign using the historical candidate-10 receipt and seed while no retained freeze receipt existed. It trusts caller-provided candidate_hash and freeze_commit and checks only retained_manifest.randomness_receipt_sha256.
critical.affected_gate: Independent scorer replay, candidate/freeze lineage, and cross-candidate receipt rejection
critical.acceptance_test: Require and strictly read the retained freeze receipt; validate its manifest digest, candidate commit/tree and bound artifacts; derive candidate/freeze from retained evidence; reject a valid receipt from another candidate.

high.evidence: Every correctly signed drand round later than the freeze is accepted. The unique first strictly subsequent round for freeze 1ebca1b is 6379697, but later rounds are also accepted, leaving post-freeze round selection under receipt-author control.
high.acceptance_test: Derive the unique first drand round strictly after the exact freeze and reject every other round, including a genuine target-plus-one receipt.

high.evidence: The production collector accepted a minimal retained manifest containing only randomness_receipt_sha256. It does not require reviewed_runtime_commit, freeze_commit, manifest.sha256 receipt entries, or the retained freeze receipt to agree.
high.affected_gate: Independent scorer replay and retained lineage
high.acceptance_test: Require the exact production manifest schema and equality of runtime candidate, freeze, receipt digests, and retained preaudit candidate commit; derive lineage from canonical retained evidence.

medium.evidence: No candidate-13 randomness receipt exists because pre-run review has not cleared; the production path correctly fails closed.
medium.acceptance_test: After the corrected candidate freezes, commit and replay the unique target-round receipt before launch.
